notes: This settles the lead. The provider is live and sells VPS. Two facts are established: the VPS prices (entry 'From $3.20/month', with 20% off on annual commitment) and the RAM ladder (VPS-1G through VPS-12G, 1 to 12 GB). What is NOT established is which price buys which RAM, because the table's Price column is a configurator link. A price with no shape cannot be ranked, so this row neither enters nor leaves the Q1 shortlist. The path shape is why earlier routes failed: the site uses .html paths (ryzen-vps-hosting.html), so /pricing, /vps and /store are all genuine 404s, not walls. Not established: the payment rails, any card hold, and the RAM of the USD 3.20 card (the configurator behind 'Configure & Order' would settle it, and it is browser-driven).
